description.value: Tamam is a fine-dining Palestinian restaurant on East Hastings Street in Vancouver, serving scratch-made dishes such as freekeh with lamb shanks, fried Mediterranean sea bass, kibbeh, and kunafah alongside Lebanese arak and BC VQA wines. The restaurant operates as a cultural gathering space and regularly runs community fundraisers with proceeds directed to Gaza. A touring cyclist will find a thoughtful menu with clearly labelled vegan and gluten-free options, catering available, and online ordering.
